contract.steps: Typed decision/event dependencies persist one bounded request, absolute deadline and validated result without a runnable job, lease or occupied worker slot
contract.authorization: Decision resume executes only inside an accepted current reviewed action and the same SQLite transaction; verified requester must own the run. Trusted external adapter must independently authenticate its provider. No anonymous endpoint is installed
contract.fences: Current persisted signing policy, HMAC token bound to occurrence/deadline, exact version and schema are checked inside the write transaction
contract.retry: Exact current-authorized request returns a retained historical receipt without reapplying later effects; changed input or unknown purged identity refuses
contract.transitions: Resume, deny, cancellation and timeout serialize one versioned transition and at most one downstream job occurrence
contract.secrets: Only key fingerprint, nonce and token digest persisted; plaintext signing key/resume tokens omitted from manifests, public inventory, events and reviewed plans
contract.inbox: Long previews wrap on phones; successful native HTML decision forms redirect to current status, while JSON/non-HTML clients preserve their JSON response

migration.legacy: Existing graph revision bytes and legacy persisted state constraints remain unchanged; waiting is derived from pending durable wait rows
migration.policy: Explicit signing key shared by controllers; increasing policy revision required for key change; retired live controllers and unknown protocols fail closed
migration.disable: Retained waits/receipts and policy fingerprints remain; new admission refuses
migration.purge: Explicit terminal retention removes associated waits/receipts; old IDs remain unknown
migration.rollback: Use a verified compatible binary/database/config snapshot; an older binary ignores the new wait contract
